name: Riba Textiles Limited
about: Riba Textiles Limited manufactures and sells terry towels, bathmats, and other textile products in North America, Europe, Asia, Oceania, and India and internationally. The company offers bath towels, such as spa, yarn dyed, plain dyed, and embroidered towels, as well as bath robes; beach towels, including double jacquard, and weft insert and stripe towels; and beach accessories comprising beach bags, mats, pillows, towels, robes, and blankets, as well as sarongs. It also provides yarn and piece dyed tufted rugs and bathmats; and bundles and bale packs. The company sells its products to departmental stores, importers, and retail chains. It exports its products to approximately 30 countries. Riba Textiles Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
